summary.text: Tom Pruss, a Libertarian who owns a Toledo printing business, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Ohio Secretary of State to Allison Russo.
He has run for the Toledo school board, Lucas County clerk of courts and, in 2024, Ohio’s 9th Congressional District, where he received about 4%.

paragraphs.text: Pruss was born in Toledo, Ohio, graduated from Calvin M. Woodward High School and attended the University of Toledo, according to Ballotpedia's profile, which draws on candidate-provided information.
He has worked in the printing industry since 1985 and has owned NorthCoast Print Mail Marketing in Toledo since 2017.
Pruss is vice president of the Northwest Ohio Polish Cultural Center and a former president of the Polish American Community of Toledo.
In 2026 he was the Libertarian nominee for Secretary of State, and he supported voter ID with free state identification, ballot access reform and ranked-choice voting.
He received 2.9% of the vote to Allison Russo's 50.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
